title: Agent Braid orchestration command error (draft, not adopted)
description: The one representation of a refusal by any SPEC-057 command: a busy lock, an unstable snapshot, an unobservable source, an over-bound or malformed input, or an existing output path. A refusal ends the command with this object (or its code on standard error), a nonzero exit status and no result object, so it can never be read as a receipt, a pre-flight verdict, a report, clean or independent. It carries a code from a closed list and optionally a declared unit id, never repository text.

resultProduced.description: Always false: a refusal is not a result.

unitId.description: A unit id from the declaration, when the refusal concerns one unit (for example an unstable worktree). Never a path or repository text.

rule.description: Name of the violated bound or rule, from the closed vocabulary of the command's help.
